# Native actor projectile fire

Survival wave 7 arms the authored chemical soldier with `m79_mp`. The actor method previously rejected every weapon except `WEAPTYPE_BULLET`, causing a script runtime error during spawn. The actor weapon resolver now accepts actual `WEAPTYPE_PROJECTILE` definitions; thrown grenade types remain separate.

`ActorFireWeapon` uses the actual composed WeaponDef and retained weaponParms layout. As in OpenBLOPS `Game/Server/game/g_weapon.cpp:1174` (`FireWeapon`), grenade-class projectiles call `Weapon_GrenadeLauncher_Fire`; other projectile classes call the retained rocket launcher. The script rocket entry shares `G_FireRocket` and omits player physical recoil. Both pass the actor as missile owner/attacker. Native missile movement, impact damage, explosion and script notifications are retained. A grenade launcher uses its native directional speed plus upward speed; this change does not invent an automatic ballistic aiming solution or substitute bullet damage.

The actor's real magazine gates launch. Only a successful missile creation consumes one round and publishes the actor fire event; an empty magazine cannot fire until the existing completed reload callback. A failed missile allocation return keeps ammunition and emits no fire event. The retained grenade-launcher entry now checks its missile result before setting launcher flags. Its pre-existing non-player guard skips inherited player velocity. `G_FireGrenade` and `G_FireRocket` guard their owner client accesses; ownership uses native entity handles.

Validation: `make run-test_actor_drop` links the actual actor fire/ammo/drop producers and passes bullet and projectile arming, grenade/rocket dispatch with actor ownership and actual definition, clip consumption, empty prevention, reload, failed launch retention and clip-only dropped launcher ammunition. Engine missile creation is a boundary stub in this portable test; real C1 projectile presentation and chemical effects require the parent-owned live wave run. No process was restarted or deployed by this worker.
